smart.label: Smart splitting (recommended)
smart.description: Use smart splitting if you are unsure which rules to choose.

advanced.label: Advanced splitting
advanced.description: Choose delimiters, paragraph length, and cleanup rules to suit the document format.

delimiter.label: Paragraph delimiters
delimiter.description: The document is split recursively using the delimiters in the order you select. Paragraphs longer than the configured length are truncated.

childChunkLength.label: Child chunk length
childChunkLength.description: Vector search uses these smaller chunks. When a chunk matches, the full paragraph is shown.

autoClean.label: Automatic cleanup
autoClean.description: (Remove redundant symbols, spaces, blank lines, and tabs)

visualEnhancement.label: Visual enhancement
visualEnhancement.description: Send images in the document to the selected model or tool and save its output as the image description.

titleAsQuestion.label: Index paragraph titles as questions
titleAsQuestion.description: Automatically add each paragraph title as a related question.

sync.title: Sync knowledge

incremental.label: Incremental sync
incremental.description: Skip unchanged documents, update changed documents, and remove documents that no longer exist in the source.

replace.label: Replace matching documents
replace.description: Fetch documents from the source again and replace matching documents. Keep existing documents with no match.

complete.label: Full sync
complete.description: Fetch and rebuild all documents from this source. Keep documents from other sources.

sync.incrementalWarning: Incremental sync updates the paragraphs of changed documents and skips unchanged documents.
sync.rebuildWarning: Sync deletes existing data before fetching fresh data. Proceed with care.
